issues.current_text: O Groq 3 LPU (Language Processing Unit), primeiro fruto da aquisição de $20bi da Groq, revelou sua arquitetura: 500 MB de SRAM on-chip, 150 TB/s de largura de banda e racks de 256 unidades a 315 PFLOPS
issues.previous_text: lançou o Groq 3 LPU para inferência de latência ultrabaixa ao lado de um rack de 256 CPUs Vera mirando Intel e AMD
issues.suggestion: Groq 3 LPU was announced yesterday. The new specs (SRAM, bandwidth, disaggregation architecture) are genuinely new detail, but the lead-in repeats the announcement. Cut the re-introduction and lead directly with what's new: the disaggregação atenção-FFN architecture and the 35x throughput-per-megawatt figure, which are the real news today.

issues.current_text: O Vera CPU completa o trio: 88 núcleos Olympus proprietários, 50% mais rápido que x86, memória LPDDR5X a 1,2 TB/s
issues.previous_text: Jensen Huang sobe ao palco domingo para apresentar o Vera CPU de 88 núcleos com a Meta como primeira implantação em escala
issues.suggestion: Vera CPU was previewed on 03-14 (88 cores, Meta deployment) and mentioned on 03-16 (rack of 256 CPUs). This is the third consecutive mention. The Olympus cores and LPDDR5X specs are new, but readers have seen '88 cores' before. Fold Vera CPU into the Groq 3 paragraph as a supporting detail rather than giving it its own sentence — the new info is the Olympus branding and the memory bandwidth, not the core count.

issues.current_text: incendiaram o terminal de Fujairah, único hub de exportação na costa leste dos Emirados
issues.previous_text: destroços de drones incendiaram o terminal de petróleo de Fujairah
issues.suggestion: Fujairah terminal fire was already reported in the 03-15 edition. If this is a NEW attack on the same target, say so explicitly ('segundo ataque ao terminal' or 'novo ataque'). If it's the same event, cut it — readers already know. As written, it reads like the same event being reported again.

issues.current_text: o runtime OpenShell para guardrails de segurança e privacidade
issues.previous_text: camada de segurança e privacidade sobre o OpenClaw com o OpenShell rodando agentes em sandbox local, de GPUs GeForce RTX até DGX Spark
issues.suggestion: OpenShell was covered in detail yesterday. Today's mention adds nothing new. Either cut it or replace with a genuinely new detail from the Agent Toolkit announcement.

issues.current_text: primeiro fruto da aquisição de $20bi da Groq
issues.previous_text: arquitetura da Groq — adquirida por US$20bi
issues.suggestion: The '$20bi acquisition' factoid has appeared on 03-14 and now 03-17. Readers know the price. Drop the acquisition context entirely — just say 'Groq 3 LPU' and let the specs speak.

issues.current_text: Aliados rejeitaram a convocação de Trump para enviar navios a Hormuz. O chanceler alemão Johann Wadephul foi direto: 'essa guerra não tem nada a ver com a OTAN'; Trump ameaçou a aliança com um 'futuro muito ruim.'
issues.previous_text: Trump disse conversar com sete países para reabrir o Estreito, mas nenhum confirmou envio de navios.
issues.suggestion: Three consecutive editions (03-15, 03-16, 03-17) frame around 'Trump asks allies to send ships, allies refuse.' The German rejection and NATO threat are genuinely new, but the framing is identical. Invert the structure: lead with the NATO fracture angle (Germany publicly breaking with the US on a military operation) rather than repeating the 'Trump convokes, allies refuse' pattern.

issues.current_text: GPU, LPU e CPU: a Nvidia controla o stack de silício completo.
issues.previous_text: Jensen Huang subiu ao palco da GTC para apresentar a Vera Rubin (...) ao lado de um rack de 256 CPUs Vera mirando Intel e AMD.
issues.suggestion: The 'Nvidia owns the full stack' narrative has been the throughline of GTC coverage for four straight days (silicon shortage 03-14, keynote preview 03-15, keynote 03-16, Day 2 details 03-17). This sentence makes it explicit, which feels like editorializing the same point yet again. Cut the summary sentence — the reader can draw the conclusion from the GPU/LPU/CPU specs listed above it.

issues.current_text: Na Ucrânia, a Rússia reivindicou 12 localidades em duas semanas
issues.previous_text: Na Ucrânia, Zelensky declarou fracassada a ofensiva russa de primavera
issues.suggestion: Two consecutive editions use 'Na Ucrânia,' as a transition clause. Vary the structure — e.g., lead with the specific fact ('A Rússia reivindicou 12 localidades...') or fold Ukraine into the broader conflict paragraph without the geographical label as a crutch.

issues.current_text: O S&P 500 subiu 1% — melhor sessão desde o início da guerra — quando o WTI caiu 5,3% a $93,50. Durou pouco: o Brent voltou a $103 na terça
issues.previous_text: O Brent fechou a US$103,14. A IEA classificou Hormuz como 'a maior interrupção de oferta da história do mercado de petróleo'
issues.suggestion: Oil price reporting follows the same pattern every edition: Brent at $103 (03-14), $106 (03-16), back to $103 (03-17). The Brent-at-$103 figure is literally the same number as 03-14. Lead with what's different — the S&P rally and gasoline hitting $3.79 are the new angles. The Brent number can be subordinate context, not the anchor.

summary: Moderate repetition driven by four consecutive days of GTC coverage (Groq 3 LPU, Vera CPU, OpenShell all re-announced) and the Hormuz crisis framing locked in a 'Trump asks, allies refuse' loop. Fujairah terminal fire appears to be the same event reported twice. Recommend consolidating GTC carry-over into 'new detail only' updates and rotating the geopolitical framing.
